name: Windows utilities · Report helpers
description: Report-generation helpers for Windows operations: structured outputs with sanitisation guidance before external sharing.
longDescription: Helpers for assembling or formatting operational reports on Windows. Intended for repeatable automation where data pulled from hosts may include sensitive identifiers; outputs should be reviewed or redacted before leaving trusted boundaries.
features: Repeatable reporting automation with predictable output locations
Awareness that operational fields may require redaction in shared reports
Scoped utilities within a shared automation monorepo
highlights: Illustrates breadth of the multi-script workbench
challenges: Light documentation relative to code size.
solutions: Source tree as reference; extend docs if the tool grows into a standalone product.
security: Sanitise data before embedding into reports shared externally
Treat host inventory output as sensitive on multi-tenant systems
